_comment: Issue #587 C1 initial budgets, completed in #656 Layer 1F. EVERY rig under tests/perf and tests/scale must be registered here — scripts/test-report/validate-nightly-wiring.mjs fails when a rig file has no entry (or an entry names a rig that no longer exists), so a new rig cannot land unbudgeted and a deleted one cannot rot here. Each rig records wall-clock nightly; after `minimumSamples` observations it fails above `regressionMultiplier` x the trailing median. `budgetMs` is the optional ABSOLUTE catastrophic-failure ceiling a rig enforces before that distribution exists; it lives here rather than as a constant inside the rig so `bun run test:ratchet` can hold it tighten-only (this file is a PERF_BUDGET_SOURCE). A rig with no `budgetMs` either carries per-measurement budgets in its own body or has no absolute ceiling by design — no absolute latency budget is invented before the distribution exists.

tests/perf/blob-egress.perf.test.ts.volume: 128 MiB local blob egress — first byte + RSS in a forked child

tests/perf/gateway-request.perf.test.ts.volume: 60 gateway GETs (p95) + a 5 s idle-CPU window

tests/perf/pwa-waterfall.perf.test.ts.volume: Chromium PWA shell + app-open request waterfall (cold vs warm)
